[List level 2] - “SPEQ SKI” remark must be entered in the PNR.

cases.reference_answer: For travel to/from LHR, LGW or CDG, request wheelchair assistance at least 48 hours before departure; late requests are not guaranteed and depend on airport operations. Bringing a personal mobility aid also has a 48-hour reservation instruction. Wheelchair assistance is free; contact KQ for other routes and requirements.

– Wheelchair Assistance:

[List level 1] - Passengers traveling to or from London Heathrow (LHR), London Gatwick (LGW), and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG) are kindly advised to request wheelchair assistance at least 48 hours before departure.

[List level 1] - Requests submitted within 48 hours of departure cannot be guaranteed, and service availability will be subject to operational constraints at the airport.

What Type of Wheelchair can you Bring?

[List level 1] - You may bring your own wheelchair or other mobility aid or assistive devices free of charge and make your reservation at least 48 hours before departure.

[List level 1] - If you have a manual wheelchair that is collapsible or dismountable, you can bring it as hand baggage as long as it doesn’t exceed the maximum dimensions as below:

committed to making your journey with your infant as smooth and comfortable as possible. We value your trust in us and look forward to serving you and your family on board.

Reduced Mobility

Passengers with Reduced Mobility

General Information

[List level 1] - Passengers with reduced mobility are those with a medical or neurodevelopmental disabilities who require individual attention, not given to passengers normally during (dis)embarkation, during the flight, during ground handling and/or in case of an emergency evacuation.

[List level 1] - Wheelchair services shall be provided to passengers free of charge. Kindly contact us through our 24-hour contact center on Tel: +254 734 104 747, Mobile: +254 711 024 747, WhatsApp: +254 705 474 747, or talk to us through 'Our Feedback Form '. We will look into the possibilities and make a reservation for you right away.

[List level 1] - Familiarize yourself with your legal rights. For flights into and out of the USA, the airline passengers with disabilities bill of rights guarantees the fundamental rights of air travelers with disabilities.

[List level 1] - Important Notice for London Heathrow (LHR), London Gatwick(LGW), and Paris Charles de Gaulle Flights(CDG) – Wheelchair Assistance:

[List level 1] - Passengers traveling to or from London Heathrow (LHR), London Gatwick (LGW), and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG) are kindly advised to request wheelchair assistance at least 48 hours before departure.

Other types of wheelchairs will be transported as check-in baggage. After checking in, you can use one of the wheelchairs we have available for you at the airport.

Passengers with reduced mobility travelling alone

Except as provided by applicable law, passengers may travel alone on our flights provided they are self supporting on board and can assist in their own evacuation should the need arise.

[List level 1] - Self-supporting means that:

[List level 1] - Passenger can be able to eat unassisted.

[List level 1] - Passenger can administer his/her medication unassisted.

[List level 1] - If necessary, the passenger can visit the lavatory unassisted. Help from the crew is limited to bringing the onboard wheelchair to the passenger and pushing it to and from the lavatory door. Therefore, the passenger shall be required to lift him/herself -using the upper body power - in and out of the onboard wheelchair unassisted.

[List level 1] - If the passenger is not self-supporting, he/she must travel with a companion(i.e., personal care attendant) who is able to perform these functions; except that for flights to and from the U.S., a safety assistant shall not be required to accompany a passenger except as permitted by applicable law.

Passengers with Reduced Mobility Travelling as a Group

1. Groups of 5 or more passengers shall be handled in a manner conforming with the normal group handling procedures, except that advance arrangements shall be made to provide additional ground equipment and assistance staff necessary, consistent with applicable law.

on the PSM to provide assistance on the ground, as well as information on the PIL/OBL enabling the crew to give the escort extra attention.

Ashes of a deceased person

[List level 1] - Guests may carry ashes of a deceased person to the cabin.

[List level 1] - The ashes shall be carried in a sealed urn.

[List level 1] - The urn shall fit under the seat or the overhead bin. It is not permitted to place the urn on a seat or in the direct view of other passengers.

[List level 1] - To avoid any request by the airport security agent to open the urn, the guest must hold the death certificate and/ or crematorium certificate.

[List level 1] - The guest shall have checked prior to travel if transit and or final destinations require "authorization for transportation certificate".

[List level 1] - A comment ‘SR OTHS KQ- Accompanied by Ashes of deceased person” shall be appended on the PNR of accompanying guest.

It is a self-service option by Kenya Airways that allows you to rebook your flight easily in case your flight is canceled or rescheduled.

Will I be charged to use the self-rebooking service?

No, The service is absolutely free.

Will my flight preferences and services remain the same?

Yes, all your service selections remain the same. I.e. same destination, same travel class, same baggage allowances.

What do I need to rebook myself?

You only need your booking reference or e-ticket number.

cases.question: How much baggage can I carry?
cases.resolved_retrieval_query: How much baggage can I carry?
cases.reference_answer: Ask for origin/destination, cabin class and whether checked or cabin baggage is meant (one concise question). A conditional overview is acceptable if clearly qualified; do not state a universal exact allowance.

chunks.text:
[List level 1] - As a mandatory standard each piece of checked in baggage shall have a name label that bears the passenger's name, physical address, and phone number on the outside and also on the inside. The name should be the same as the one mentioned on the ticket. An email address is also recommended.

Exceptions

[List level 1] - Guests travelling from Jeddah are allowed to carry one free bottle of Holy Water, Max 5 Litres. The bottle must be sealed with a plastic covering to avoid leakage. KQ has no liability on Holy Water, no claims shall be filed. Note: For ease of handling, the maximum weight of each piece of baggage shall not exceed 23kgs (50Ibs) and total dimensions shall not exceed 158cms (62 inches) (L+W+H)

[List level 1] - Under special conditions or authorization, non-normal item, motorized wheelchairs, special sporting equipment may be accepted as checked baggage with exceeding weight of 23kgs.

[List level 1] - In addition to free cabin baggage allowance, an infant is entitled to 1 collapsible stroller plus 1 car seat free of charge.

[List level 1] - Incapacitated passengers may carry one wheelchair or mobility device free of charge.

[List level 1] - The actual free allowance of the guest may differ if code share or interline traffic is involved. In these cases, the allowance is automatically calculated in compliance with IATA Resolution 302.

[List level 1] - Free baggage allowance applied will be as stated in the Departure Control System (DCS) or on the e-ticket.

Interline and Codeshare Allowance and Sharing Policy

All cabin baggage shall have an "approved KQ cabin luggage" label attached as conformance to cabin baggage standards.

NOTE

[List level 1] - On top of the free cabin allowance, passengers are allowed to carry 01 bag of Duty Free in the cabin as accessories column above.

[List level 1] - Infants < 2 years NOT occupying a seat shall be allowed 1 piece of cabin baggage MAX 12kgs and MAX dimensions L55 x W25 x H35.

[List level 1] - For infants and small children who are seated on a passenger seat and need to be secured with an approved device for their comfort on board i.e car seat; the car seat used on board may be accepted on top of the normal free cabin baggage allowance. At the time of reservations, the accompanying person shall be informed that he/she is responsible for the installation of the car seat on board in compliance with the safety and installation instructions of the manufacturer.

[List level 1] - Some Airport Authorities or airlines may impose further restrictions for cabin baggage amount, size and/or weight. In such cases allowable piece shall be checked in free of charge, provided the size and weight are within the cabin baggage allowance weight. If not, normal excess baggage charges apply.

8.6 Checked Baggage

8.6.1 Upon delivery to us of your Baggage which you wish to check, we will take custody of, and issue a Baggage Identification Tag for, each piece of your Checked Baggage.

8.6.2 Checked Baggage must have your name or other personal identification affixed to it.

8.6.3 Checked Baggage will, whenever possible, be carried on the same aircraft as you, unless we decide for safety, security or operational reasons to carry it on an alternative flight. If your Checked Baggage is carried on a subsequent flight we will deliver it to you, unless applicable law requires you to be present for customs clearance.

[List level 1] - For some types of special baggage advance reservations should be made or Kenya Airways may refuse acceptance if deemed necessary.

[List level 1] - If accepted, baggage shall be packed by the passenger in such a way that the item and/or its contents are sufficiently protected to endure ordinary handling.

[List level 1] - Odd size baggage cannot always be accepted. Acceptance depends on the capacity of the aircraft operating on the passenger’s routing. [List level 1] - When a passenger presents special baggage for check-in, the Customer Service Agent shall check the PNR of the passenger to verify whether transportation has been granted.

[List level 1] - If the special clearance is missing in the customer records, the station shall decide to accept it for transport, provided KQ procedures are strictly adhered to.

More Information

Bulky Baggage:

[List level 1] - For any baggage whose dimensions are larger than 300cm (Length +Width height) or heavier than 32kgs authorization shall be given prior travel by the commercial team. Lower limitation may apply for sports equipment.

Baggage Conditions Rules

Baggage Conditions link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/conditions-of-carriage-baggage/

Article 8 Baggage

8.1 Free Baggage Allowance

You may carry some Baggage, free of charge, subject to our conditions and limitations, which are available on our website Baggage information (Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/ )

8.2 Excess Baggage

You will be required to pay a charge for carriage of Baggage in excess of the free Baggage allowance. To learn more about  the rates kindly reach out to us on +254711024747.

8.3 Items Unacceptable as Baggage

8.3.1 You must not include in your Baggage:

8.3.1.2 Items the carriage of which is prohibited by the applicable laws, regulations or orders of any state to be flown from or to;

8.3.1.3 Items which are reasonably considered by us to be unsuitable for carriage because they are dangerous or unsafe, or because of their weight, size, shape or character, or because they are fragile or perishable having regard to, among other things, the type of aircraft being used. Information about unacceptable items is available upon request.

8.3.2 Firearms and ammunition other than for hunting and sporting purposes are prohibited from carriage as Baggage. Firearms and ammunition for hunting and sporting purposes may be accepted as Checked Baggage. Firearms must be unloaded, with the safety catch on, and suitably packed. Carriage of ammunition is subject to ICAO and IATA regulations as specified in Article 8.3.1.1.

we may refuse to carry you and your Baggage. In the event a search or scan causes Damage to you, or an x-ray or scan causes damage to your Baggage, we shall not be liable for such Damage unless due to our fault or negligence.

8.6 Checked Baggage

8.6.1 Upon delivery to us of your Baggage which you wish to check, we will take custody of, and issue a Baggage Identification Tag for, each piece of your Checked Baggage.

8.6.2 Checked Baggage must have your name or other personal identification affixed to it.

8.6.3 Checked Baggage will, whenever possible, be carried on the same aircraft as you, unless we decide for safety, security or operational reasons to carry it on an alternative flight. If your Checked Baggage is carried on a subsequent flight we will deliver it to you, unless applicable law requires you to be present for customs clearance.

8.7 Unchecked Baggage

8.7.1 We may specify maximum dimensions and/or weight for Baggage which you carry on to the aircraft. If we have not done so, Baggage which you carry onto the aircraft must fit under the seat in front of you or in an enclosed storage compartment in the cabin of the aircraft. If your Baggage cannot be stored in this manner, or is of excessive weight, or is considered unsafe for any reason, it must be carried as Checked Baggage, subject to Articles 8.2 and 8.3.

Bulky Baggage:

[List level 1] - For any baggage whose dimensions are larger than 300cm (Length +Width height) or heavier than 32kgs authorization shall be given prior travel by the commercial team. Lower limitation may apply for sports equipment.

[List level 1] - Authorization will appear in the PNR with “XBAG comment”. If the baggage exceeds 32kgs or 300cms a “bulky XBAG transportation” message specifying the type and the dimensions is sent to the station.

[List level 1] - There is no weight limitation for wheelchair and mobility device however a comment has to be given on the PNR to enable plan for the right aircraft and ground handling process.

Fragile Baggage:

[List level 1] - Kenya Airways accepts no liability for fragile baggage, baggage with fragile contents, perishable items e-g food, meat, flowers etc. and Valuable. This information should be given to the passenger before accepting of such items.

[List level 1] - For fragile baggage the item shall be packed properly (original sealed box or suitable case) in order to endure normal handling. Mark “fragile” on the limited release part of the bag and a fragile sticker is affix on to the bag.

[List level 1] - Where perishable items require controlled temperature or specialized handling, passengers should be advised to transport as cargo.

[List level 1] - The passenger is responsible for ensuring the conformity of the health documents required for the trip and for hermetically packing in order to prevent any leaks, drips or odor.

pouch, fragile items, musical instruments, paintings etc.)

Baggage Allowance for an Extra seat purchased

Acceptance Conditions

[List level 1] - Extra seat(s) shall be requested and paid for in advance. Approval is needed from Revenue Management.

[List level 1] - The normal applicable free checked baggage allowance applies for every extra seat booked (EXST). For example, 1 passenger books 2 extra M-Class seats for comfort. The total checked baggage allowance for this passenger will be 3 x applicable free baggage allowance.

[List level 1] - If a seat is used to place items on (CBBG), these items may not weigh more than 46 kg per seat.

[List level 1] - (The kilos placed on a seat, shall not be deducted from the total free checked baggage allowance.) Items placed on a seat should be adequately packed to prevent damage.

[List level 1] - Trunks and crates are not allowed as CBBG.

[List level 1] - Items must be stored on a seat and be properly secured by a safety belt or restraint device having enough strength to eliminate the possibility of shifting under all normal anticipated flight and ground conditions.

[List level 1] - The item shall be adequately packaged or covered in a manner to avoid possible injury to passengers and cabin crew members.

[List level 1] - Extra seats for stowage of items shall not be issued on the emergency exit row.

[List level 1] - The items carried on the extra seat shall not restrict access to or use of any required emergency or regular exit, or aisle(s) in the cabin.

cases.resolved_retrieval_query: Can I carry a mobility aid and request airport assistance?
cases.reference_answer: Wheelchair services and personal wheelchairs/mobility aids are free. Reserve the personal aid at least 48 hours before departure and contact KQ to request assistance. For LHR/LGW/CDG, request wheelchair assistance at least 48 hours before departure; late requests are not guaranteed. Cabin acceptance for collapsible manual wheelchairs depends on the specified aircraft limits; other types are checked.

chunks.text:
Other types of wheelchairs will be transported as check-in baggage. After checking in, you can use one of the wheelchairs we have available for you at the airport.

Passengers with reduced mobility travelling alone

Except as provided by applicable law, passengers may travel alone on our flights provided they are self supporting on board and can assist in their own evacuation should the need arise.

[List level 1] - Self-supporting means that:

[List level 1] - Passenger can be able to eat unassisted.

[List level 1] - Passenger can administer his/her medication unassisted.

[List level 1] - If necessary, the passenger can visit the lavatory unassisted. Help from the crew is limited to bringing the onboard wheelchair to the passenger and pushing it to and from the lavatory door. Therefore, the passenger shall be required to lift him/herself -using the upper body power - in and out of the onboard wheelchair unassisted.

[List level 1] - If the passenger is not self-supporting, he/she must travel with a companion(i.e., personal care attendant) who is able to perform these functions; except that for flights to and from the U.S., a safety assistant shall not be required to accompany a passenger except as permitted by applicable law.

Passengers with Reduced Mobility Travelling as a Group

1. Groups of 5 or more passengers shall be handled in a manner conforming with the normal group handling procedures, except that advance arrangements shall be made to provide additional ground equipment and assistance staff necessary, consistent with applicable law.

Yes, you can book for another person travelling from abroad. What do I need to rebook myself?

You only need your booking reference or e-ticket number.

Where do I go to rebook my flight?

Simply visit the Kenya Airways website(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ), select “Manage Booking”

You will find the rebooking link at the top marked “Click here.

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

Once you log in, you will be redirected to a page that has all available flight options and timings.

*Flight timings available for rebooking are either less than 24 hours from your original flight or 7 days after.

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self-rebooking.

What happens if I do not rebook myself/are not able to rebook?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight, after which you will receive an email with your new flight details.

Will I receive my e-ticket and boarding pass?

Yes, after you have selected and confirmed your new flight, you will receive an email confirmation as well as your e-ticket.

I have received an email that my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

Booking & Payment FAQs

What are my payment options?

Pay quickly and efficiently through any of our payment options: credit and debit cards, eWallet , mobile payment or real-time bank transfer. Read more about our payments options.(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/book-manage/booking-online/payment-methods/ )

Can I make an online payment in a currency of my choice?

Our prices are automatically displayed based on the country you are booking from.

For example, if you are in the United Kingdom, booking a flight from Nairobi to London, the price displayed, and the price you need to pay, will be in British Pound.

Please note that if you’re paying with a different currency from your card, your financial institution may apply different exchange rates to the fare displayed on the booking page. There may be additional charges incurred, so please check with your financial institution before making your booking.

Can I make changes to my flight details?

Manage My Booking allows you to modify an existing flight booking:

[List level 1] - Change travel dates

[List level 1] - Purchase extra legroom

[List level 1] - Update contact information

[List level 1] - Pay in advance for excess baggage

[List level 1] - Request for refund

What do I need to rebook myself?

You only need your booking reference or e-ticket number.

Where do I go to rebook my flight?

Simply visit the Kenya Airways website(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ), select “Manage Booking”

You will find the rebooking link at the top marked “Click here.

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

Once you log in, you will be redirected to a page that has all available flight options and timings.

*Flight timings available for rebooking are either less than 24 hours from your original flight or 7 days after.

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self-rebooking.

What happens if I do not rebook myself/are not able to rebook?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight, after which you will receive an email with your new flight details.

Will I receive my e-ticket and boarding pass?

Yes, after you have selected and confirmed your new flight, you will receive an email confirmation as well as your e-ticket.

I have received an email that my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

When can I Check in?

Online Check-in:

With an electronic ticket, online check-in can be performed from 48 hours up until 1 hour before departure. By taking advantage of this service, you can bypass long lines at selected airports and even pick your preferred seat. Once completed, you can print your boarding pass at your convenience. When you arrive at the airport, use the designated online check-in drop-off point for your luggage and then proceed to the boarding gate. Kenya Airways has taken online check-in to new heights, providing a smoother and more convenient experience.

International Check-in:

For international flights, it is mandatory for all passengers to complete the check-in process a minimum of two and a half hours before the flight's departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close precisely one hour before the scheduled departure time.

Domestic Check-in:

Passengers traveling on domestic flights must present a valid form of identification during check-in. It is required to complete the check-in process at least one and a half hours prior to departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close half an hour before takeoff.

Use the reference to track the bag online or call the baggage number listed in the policy (+254-20-3274747). If delayed, delivery to a local address may be arranged where permitted; compensation is a separate process.

First Needs Allowance (FNA) Payment:

Payment may be made to passengers who arrive at destinations other than their domicile country of residence without their checked baggage. It shall be noted that not all such passengers may need payment.

NOTE: Persons who are residents do not qualify for first needs payment, unless they show proof of residence in another country other than their domicile country for the last 6 months.

The following provisions shall therefore apply for delayed bags not received within 24hrs at the arrival airport where the missing report was filed: after 24 hours:

[List level 1] - First Needs Allowance (FNA) may be paid on the spot where it is ascertained that based on flight schedules, frequencies and connectivity, the missing bags shall not arrive within 24hours.

[List level 1] - Passengers receiving at least one of their bags may not be entitled to First Needs Allowance.

[List level 1] - Proof of Purchase of first needs items in form of receipts is required;

[List level 1] - Only essential items can be reimbursed;

[List level 1] - Applicable limits are:

[List level 1] - USD150 for First class and Premier World

[List level 1] - USD100 for Economy class passengers

[List level 1] - Children between 2-12 yrs. are entitled to 50% of the applicable limits in Economy and Business Class

8.8 COLLECTION AND DELIVERY OF CHECKED BAGGAGE

8.8.1 Subject to Article 8.6.3, you are required to collect your Checked Baggage as soon as it is made available at your destination or Stopover. Should you not collect it within a reasonable time, we may charge you a storage fee. Should your Checked Baggage not be claimed within three (3) months of the time it is made available, we may dispose of it without any liability to you.

8.8.2 Only the bearer of the Baggage Check and Baggage Identification Tag is entitled to delivery of the Checked Baggage.

8.8.3 If a person claiming Checked Baggage is unable to produce the Baggage Check and identify the Baggage by means of a Baggage Identification Tag, we will deliver the Baggage to such person only on condition that he or she establishes to our satisfaction his or her right to the Baggage.

Please be advised that if you do not show up for any flight without advising us in advance, we may cancel your return or onward reservations. However, if you do advise us in advance, we will not cancel your subsequent flight reservations.

ARTICLE 6: CHECK IN AND BOARDING

6.1 Check-in Deadlines vary by airport; however, as a minimum standard, passengers must complete check-in at least 60 minutes before departure for Economy Class flights, 90 minutes before departure for Business Class flights, and 120 minutes before departure for long-haul international flights. We strongly recommend allowing additional time to complete security, immigration, and other formalities. We or our Authorized Agents will advise you of the Check-in Deadline for your first flight with us; for all onward or connecting flights, you are solely responsible for informing yourself of the applicable Check-in Deadlines. If you do not complete check-in by the required time, we may cancel your reservation and deny boarding without liability.

6.2 You must be present at the boarding gate not later than the time specified by us when you check-in. Failure to do so may result in the cancellation of your reserved space and the off-loading of your checked baggage in accordance with safety and security requirements.

If your Checked Baggage is carried on a subsequent flight we will deliver it to you, unless applicable law requires you to be present for customs clearance.

8.6.4 You must ensure that your Checked Baggage is sufficiently robust and well secured to withstand the usual and normal rigors of carriage by air without sustaining damage (except for fair wear and tear).

8.7 UNCHECKED BAGGAGE

8.7.1 We may specify maximum dimensions and/or weight for Baggage which you carry on to the aircraft. If we have not done so, Baggage which you carry onto the aircraft must fit under the seat in front of you or in an enclosed storage compartment in the cabin of the aircraft. If your Baggage cannot be stored in this manner, or is of excessive weight, or is considered unsafe for any reason, it must be carried as Checked Baggage, subject to Articles 8.2 and 8.3.

[List level 1] - Passengers receiving at least one of their bags may not be entitled to First Needs Allowance.

[List level 1] - Applicable limits are:

passengers should be advised to transport as cargo.

[List level 1] - Baggage shall be packed in such a way that it should endure normal handling.

[List level 1] - Items that, because of their nature, could cause damage to other passenger’s baggage (e.g. Spillable liquid) shall not be accepted for check-in.

Medicines:

Kenya Airways has no restrictions on the carriage of medicines except when the medicine is classified as Dangerous Goods such as:

[List level 1] - An inflammable liquid

[List level 1] - Toxic, infectious or radioactive material

[List level 1] - A gas

Although Helium is not considered as Dangerous Goods, the transportation of balloons filled up with Helium is forbidden because they can explode onboard.

Can I offer different amounts for the Upgrade for each segment of my journey?

Yes, you can offer different amounts for each eligible segment.

How much does it cost to make an offer?

The offer is free of charge. Only if you receive the Upgrade, your credit card will be debited with the amount of your offer. Please, we still need your credit card details at the time of making your offer for standard verification purposes.

Can I change my Offer to a higher or lower amount?

Yes, you can change the amount before you receive a confirmation email informing you whether your Offer has been successful or not. All you need to do to change your Offer is to use the link from the upgrade offer email.

Apart from the Upgrade amount displayed, will there be additional taxes or charges?

No.

What happens if an Offer has been submitted, but the flight has to be changed or cancelled?

You may change or cancel your offer up to 13 hours before departure.

What happens if your Upgrade has been accepted, but you have to cancel your trip?

After your offer has been accepted, the Upgrade amount is no longer refundable.

What happens if your upgrade has been accepted, but KQ cancels your flight?

Your Upgrade remains valid if you a re-booked to another KQ flight at the same amount. Otherwise, we will refund the amount.

Up to 13 hours before departure you may cancel, correct your offer or re-offer.

No.

Can I pay for a ticket for another person travelling from abroad?

Yes, you can book for another person travelling from abroad. However, if you choose to pay with credit or debit cards you may be required to present the card used for booking, it must be presented while checking into your flight at the commencement of travel. If you, as the credit card holder, are not travelling, a copy of the credit card with an authorization signed by yourself should be presented at check-in. alternatively, the card or a copy of the card with your signed authorization can be presented to the nearest Kenya airways ticketing office at least 72 hours before the flight. This verification is required to ensure a smooth check-in process at the airport and to avoid being refused carriage. Failure to comply will result in the requirement to pay the full ticket cost at the airport or refusal of carriage.

Is it possible for one to modify Multicity bookings online?

No, It is not possible for any changes to be made on multi-city bookings.

Can one make changes online to bookings that have been affected by schedule change?

No, one has to call our Contact center for Assistance.

When one is a no show can they make any changes to their booking online?

No this is not possible, one has to call our contact center for Assistance.

Is it possible for one to modify bookings online that have already been modified offline?

No,once changes have been made to a booking offline they cannot be modified online.

Can one change a group PNR?

No, The maximum number of passengers in a booking that can be modified is 9

Can one modify an award ticket online?

No, Tickets purchased with miles  cannot be modified online

Can one change a booking one hour to flight time?

No, kindly call the Contact center for Assistance

What is Upgrade to Business Class?

Kenya Airways offers you the opportunity to determine your own price for your Business Class upgrade by submitting an offer. KQ will inform you 12 hours before departure whether or not your Upgrade has been approved.

On which routes is Upgrade to Business Class being offered?

KQ offers Upgrades on all scheduled flights in all routes.

Who can make an Offer for an Upgrade?

To be able to make an offer you need a valid and issued KQ Economy Class ticket for a scheduled flight operated by KQ. You may submit your Smart Upgrade offer up to 14 hours before Departure.

cases.resolved_retrieval_query: Can a discounted non-refundable ticket ever receive a credit after force majeure?
cases.reference_answer: Yes. For a completely unused discounted ticket with a non-refundable amount, if force majeure prevents travel, promptly notify KQ and provide evidence. The name on the Ticket must exactly match the name in the Passenger’s valid passport or travel document. Travel may be denied if the names do not match.

3.1.2 A Ticket is not transferable, except as required by any locally applicable laws.

3.1.3 Some Tickets are sold at discounted fares which may be partially or completely non-refundable. You should choose the fare best suited to your needs. You may also wish to ensure that you have appropriate insurance to cover instances where you have to cancel your Ticket.

3.1.4 If you have a Ticket, as described in Article 3.1.3, which is completely unused, and you are prevented from travelling due to Force Majeure, provided that you promptly advise us and furnish evidence of such Force Majeure, we will provide you with a credit of the non-refundable amount of the fare, for future travel on us, subject to deduction of a reasonable administration fee. Such credit will remain valid for a minimum of twelve (12) months from the date of issue.

3.1.5 The Ticket is and remains at all times the property of the issuing carrier.

3.1.6 You shall not be entitled to be carried on a flight unless you provide positive identification and a valid Electronic Ticket duly issued in your name.

3.1.7 A ticket is valuable and you should take appropriate measures to safeguard it.

3.2 PERIOD OF VALIDITY

Ticket and Will Not be Traveling. Can I Obtain a Refund?:

[List level 1] - You have one year from the ticket's original issue date to reschedule your travel without losing the full value of the ticket (less any applicable change fees).

[List level 1] - In addition should the Passenger not travel on a flight and they are holding a refundable or a non refundable ticket they are equally to benefit from a refund of said applicable taxes, charges and other fees.

or other value document held in our database.   "ELECTRONIC TICKET" means the Itinerary/Receipt issued by us or on our behalf, the Electronic Coupons and, if applicable, a boarding document, and shall have the same legal validity as a paper Ticket.

"FLIGHT COUPON" means that portion of the Ticket that bears the notation "good for passage," or in the case of an Electronic Ticket, the Electronic Coupon, and indicates the particular places between which you are entitled to be carried.

Taxes, Fees and Charges:

[List level 1] - Applicable taxes, fees and charges imposed by government or other authority, or by the operator of an airport, shall be payable by you. If there is an increase in a tax, fee or charge shown on the Ticket, you will be obliged to pay it. Likewise, if a new tax, fee or charge is imposed even after Ticket issuance, you will be obliged to pay it. Similarly, in the event any taxes, fees or charges which you have paid to us at the time of Ticket issuance are abolished or reduced such that they no longer apply to you, or a lesser amount is due, you will be entitled to claim a refund.

In addition should the Passenger not travel on a flight and they are holding a refundable or a non refundable ticket they are equally to benefit from a refund of said applicable taxes, charges and other fees.

When can I Check in?

Online Check-in:

With an electronic ticket, online check-in can be performed from 48 hours up until 1 hour before departure. By taking advantage of this service, you can bypass long lines at selected airports and even pick your preferred seat. Once completed, you can print your boarding pass at your convenience. International Check-in:

Baggage Allowance for an Extra seat purchased

Acceptance Conditions

[List level 1] - Extra seat(s) shall be requested and paid for in advance. Approval is needed from Revenue Management.

[List level 1] - The normal applicable free checked baggage allowance applies for every extra seat booked (EXST). For example, 1 passenger books 2 extra M-Class seats for comfort. The total checked baggage allowance for this passenger will be 3 x applicable free baggage allowance.

[List level 1] - If a seat is used to place items on (CBBG), these items may not weigh more than 46 kg per seat.

[List level 1] - (The kilos placed on a seat, shall not be deducted from the total free checked baggage allowance.) Items placed on a seat should be adequately packed to prevent damage.

[List level 1] - Trunks and crates are not allowed as CBBG.

[List level 1] - Items must be stored on a seat and be properly secured by a safety belt or restraint device having enough strength to eliminate the possibility of shifting under all normal anticipated flight and ground conditions.

[List level 1] - The item shall be adequately packaged or covered in a manner to avoid possible injury to passengers and cabin crew members.

[List level 1] - Extra seats for stowage of items shall not be issued on the emergency exit row.

[List level 1] - The items carried on the extra seat shall not restrict access to or use of any required emergency or regular exit, or aisle(s) in the cabin.

Note:

[List level 1] - When an extra seat is purchased to transport baggage in cabin, CCBG, the standard baggage allowance applies for every extra seat purchased.

[List level 1] - When an extra seat is purchased for comfort, EXST, the standard baggage allowance applies for every extra seat purchased.

Exception:
When an extra seat is purchased for corpulent passenger, the extra seat does not benefit of a free baggage allowance.

[List level 1] - (The kilos placed on a seat, shall not be deducted from the total free checked baggage allowance.) Items placed on a seat should be adequately packed to prevent damage.

[List level 1] - Trunks and crates are not allowed as CBBG.

[List level 1] - Items must be stored on a seat and be properly secured by a safety belt or restraint device having enough strength to eliminate the possibility of shifting under all normal anticipated flight and ground conditions.

[List level 1] - The item shall be adequately packaged or covered in a manner to avoid possible injury to passengers and cabin crew members.

[List level 1] - Extra seats for stowage of items shall not be issued on the emergency exit row.

When can I Check in?

Online Check-in:

With an electronic ticket, online check-in can be performed from 48 hours up until 1 hour before departure. By taking advantage of this service, you can bypass long lines at selected airports and even pick your preferred seat. Once completed, you can print your boarding pass at your convenience. When you arrive at the airport, use the designated online check-in drop-off point for your luggage and then proceed to the boarding gate. Kenya Airways has taken online check-in to new heights, providing a smoother and more convenient experience.

International Check-in:

For international flights, it is mandatory for all passengers to complete the check-in process a minimum of two and a half hours before the flight's departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close precisely one hour before the scheduled departure time.

Domestic Check-in:

Passengers traveling on domestic flights must present a valid form of identification during check-in. It is required to complete the check-in process at least one and a half hours prior to departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close half an hour before takeoff.

Can I make an online payment in a currency of my choice?

"ITINERARY/RECEIPT" means a document or documents issued by us or on our behalf to Passengers travelling on Electronic Tickets that contains the Passenger's name, flight information and notices.

First Needs Allowance (FNA) Payment:

Payment may be made to passengers who arrive at destinations other than their domicile country of residence without their checked baggage. It shall be noted that not all such passengers may need payment.

NOTE: Persons who are residents do not qualify for first needs payment, unless they show proof of residence in another country other than their domicile country for the last 6 months.

The following provisions shall therefore apply for delayed bags not received within 24hrs at the arrival airport where the missing report was filed: after 24 hours:

[List level 1] - First Needs Allowance (FNA) may be paid on the spot where it is ascertained that based on flight schedules, frequencies and connectivity, the missing bags shall not arrive within 24hours.

[List level 1] - Proof of Purchase of first needs items in form of receipts is required;

[List level 1] - Only essential items can be reimbursed;

[List level 1] - Applicable limits are:

By optig for online check-in, you're not just saving time; you're ensuring a smooth and stress-free start to your journey. Say goodbye to long lines and hello to an effortless way to prepare for your flight

When can I Check in?

Online Check-in:

With an electronic ticket, online check-in can be performed from 48 hours up until 1 hour before departure. By taking advantage of this service, you can bypass long lines at selected airports and even pick your preferred seat. Once completed, you can print your boarding pass at your convenience. When you arrive at the airport, use the designated online check-in drop-off point for your luggage and then proceed to the boarding gate. Kenya Airways has taken online check-in to new heights, providing a smoother and more convenient experience.

International Check-in:

For international flights, it is mandatory for all passengers to complete the check-in process a minimum of two and a half hours before the flight's departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close precisely one hour before the scheduled departure time.

Domestic Check-in:

Passengers traveling on domestic flights must present a valid form of identification during check-in. It is required to complete the check-in process at least one and a half hours prior to departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close half an hour before takeoff.

cases.resolved_retrieval_query: Can I carry a mobility aid and request airport assistance?
cases.reference_answer: Wheelchair services and personal wheelchairs/mobility aids are free. Reserve the personal aid at least 48 hours before departure and contact KQ to request assistance. For LHR/LGW/CDG, request wheelchair assistance at least 48 hours before departure; late requests are not guaranteed. Cabin acceptance for collapsible manual wheelchairs depends on the specified aircraft limits; other types are checked.

Other types of wheelchairs will be transported as check-in baggage. After checking in, you can use one of the wheelchairs we have available for you at the airport.

Passengers with reduced mobility travelling alone

Except as provided by applicable law, passengers may travel alone on our flights provided they are self supporting on board and can assist in their own evacuation should the need arise.

[List level 1] - Self-supporting means that:

[List level 1] - Passenger can be able to eat unassisted.

[List level 1] - Passenger can administer his/her medication unassisted.

[List level 1] - If necessary, the passenger can visit the lavatory unassisted. Help from the crew is limited to bringing the onboard wheelchair to the passenger and pushing it to and from the lavatory door. Therefore, the passenger shall be required to lift him/herself -using the upper body power - in and out of the onboard wheelchair unassisted.

[List level 1] - If the passenger is not self-supporting, he/she must travel with a companion(i.e., personal care attendant) who is able to perform these functions; except that for flights to and from the U.S., a safety assistant shall not be required to accompany a passenger except as permitted by applicable law.

Passengers with Reduced Mobility Travelling as a Group

1. Groups of 5 or more passengers shall be handled in a manner conforming with the normal group handling procedures, except that advance arrangements shall be made to provide additional ground equipment and assistance staff necessary, consistent with applicable law.

– Wheelchair Assistance:

[List level 1] - Passengers traveling to or from London Heathrow (LHR), London Gatwick (LGW), and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG) are kindly advised to request wheelchair assistance at least 48 hours before departure.

[List level 1] - Requests submitted within 48 hours of departure cannot be guaranteed, and service availability will be subject to operational constraints at the airport.

What Type of Wheelchair can you Bring?

[List level 1] - You may bring your own wheelchair or other mobility aid or assistive devices free of charge and make your reservation at least 48 hours before departure.

[List level 1] - If you have a manual wheelchair that is collapsible or dismountable, you can bring it as hand baggage as long as it doesn’t exceed the maximum dimensions as below:

After booking your flight on Kenya-airways.com you will receive your ticket via e-mail as soon as we have received the payment.

Can I pay for a ticket for another person travelling from abroad?

Yes, you can book for another person travelling from abroad. However, if you choose to pay with credit or debit cards you may be required to present the card used for booking, it must be presented while checking into your flight at the commencement of travel. If you, as the credit card holder, are not travelling, a copy of the credit card with an authorization signed by yourself should be presented at check-in. alternatively, the card or a copy of the card with your signed authorization can be presented to the nearest Kenya airways ticketing office at least 72 hours before the flight. This verification is required to ensure a smooth check-in process at the airport and to avoid being refused carriage. Failure to comply will result in the requirement to pay the full ticket cost at the airport or refusal of carriage.

Is it possible for one to modify Multicity bookings online?

No, It is not possible for any changes to be made on multi-city bookings.

Can one make changes online to bookings that have been affected by schedule change?

No, one has to call our Contact center for Assistance.

When one is a no show can they make any changes to their booking online?

No this is not possible, one has to call our contact center for Assistance.

What happens to bookings that have been cancelled?

chunks.text:
– Wheelchair Assistance:

[List level 1] - Passengers traveling to or from London Heathrow (LHR), London Gatwick (LGW), and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG) are kindly advised to request wheelchair assistance at least 48 hours before departure.

[List level 1] - Requests submitted within 48 hours of departure cannot be guaranteed, and service availability will be subject to operational constraints at the airport.

What Type of Wheelchair can you Bring?

[List level 1] - You may bring your own wheelchair or other mobility aid or assistive devices free of charge and make your reservation at least 48 hours before departure.

[List level 1] - If you have a manual wheelchair that is collapsible or dismountable, you can bring it as hand baggage as long as it doesn’t exceed the maximum dimensions as below:

Other types of wheelchairs will be transported as check-in baggage. After checking in, you can use one of the wheelchairs we have available for you at the airport.

Passengers with reduced mobility travelling alone

Except as provided by applicable law, passengers may travel alone on our flights provided they are self supporting on board and can assist in their own evacuation should the need arise.

[List level 1] - Self-supporting means that:

[List level 1] - Passenger can be able to eat unassisted.

[List level 1] - Passenger can administer his/her medication unassisted.

[List level 1] - If necessary, the passenger can visit the lavatory unassisted. Help from the crew is limited to bringing the onboard wheelchair to the passenger and pushing it to and from the lavatory door. Therefore, the passenger shall be required to lift him/herself -using the upper body power - in and out of the onboard wheelchair unassisted.

[List level 1] - If the passenger is not self-supporting, he/she must travel with a companion(i.e., personal care attendant) who is able to perform these functions; except that for flights to and from the U.S., a safety assistant shall not be required to accompany a passenger except as permitted by applicable law.

Passengers with Reduced Mobility Travelling as a Group

1. Groups of 5 or more passengers shall be handled in a manner conforming with the normal group handling procedures, except that advance arrangements shall be made to provide additional ground equipment and assistance staff necessary, consistent with applicable law.

What do I need to rebook myself?

You only need your booking reference or e-ticket number.

Where do I go to rebook my flight?

Simply visit the Kenya Airways website(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ), select “Manage Booking”

You will find the rebooking link at the top marked “Click here.

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

Once you log in, you will be redirected to a page that has all available flight options and timings.

*Flight timings available for rebooking are either less than 24 hours from your original flight or 7 days after.

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self-rebooking.

What happens if I do not rebook myself/are not able to rebook?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight, after which you will receive an email with your new flight details.

Will I receive my e-ticket and boarding pass?

Yes, after you have selected and confirmed your new flight, you will receive an email confirmation as well as your e-ticket.

I have received an email that my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

Passengers traveling on domestic flights must present a valid form of identification during check-in. It is required to complete the check-in process at least one and a half hours prior to departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close half an hour before takeoff.

What should I do if my Promotional Code is not working?

Use the feedback icon hanging on the right side of your browsing window

Where do I present my credit/debit card?

If Kenya Airways advise you to present the card used for booking, it must be presented while checking into your flight at the commencement of travel. If you, as the credit card holder, are not travelling, a copy of the credit card with an authorization signed by yourself should be presented at check-in.

Alternatively, the card or a copy of the card with your signed authorization can be presented to the nearest Kenya Airways ticketing office at least 72 hours before the flight. This verification is required to ensure a smooth check-in process at the airport and to avoid being denied access to board. Failure to comply will result in the requirement to pay the full ticket cost at the airport.

What should I do if something went wrong with my payment?

Do I need to call Kenya Airways to reconfirm my flight?

If your booking is successful, there is no need to call us. You can check in online or at the airport on the day of departure.

What is an Extra Legroom Seat?

The extra Legroom Seats are located in Economy Class exit rows with a generous space for you to stretch out. It is offered only on Kenya Airways-operated flights and is not available on flights operated by our partner airlines.

Extra Legroom Seats are subject to availability, terms & conditions, and other eligibility requirements. Please view all requirements before making your purchase to ensure you meet all of the criteria.

Who can book an Extra Legroom Seat?

Below is a summary of the eligibility requirements.

Guest must:

[List level 1] - Be physically able to reach, locate and operate the emergency exit window or door, and to quickly pass through the exit.

[List level 1] - Be able to understand and acknowledge instructions in English.

[List level 1] - Be aged 18 years or older and not have any conditions.

[List level 1] - Not be travelling with children or infants, a care giver, a guide dog or an assistance animal.

[List level 1] - Not be in any stage of pregnancy

[List level 1] - How do I book an Extra Legroom Seat?

If you meet the exit row seat safety requirements, we strongly recommend you to book early as seats are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Extra Legroom Seats are subject to availability, terms & conditions, and other eligibility requirements.

went wrong with my payment?

Please talk to us through our Customer Service Support Section on the website where you will get real time feedback or you can contact our Global Contact Center.

What currency should I use to pay at Kenya-airways.com?

Bookings made at Kenya-airways.com should be paid for in the currency in which the ticket price is calculated locally. If you make a booking at Kenya-airways.com, the price for your ticket will be shown throughout the booking procedure in the currency you will ultimately use to pay for the ticket. It is not possible to pay in any other currency than what is indicated at Kenya-airways.com

What form of payments can I use to pay for Time to Think?

You may use any form of payment acceptable on the Website or Mobile App and any of our Ticketing offices i.e Credit cards, Debit cards, M-pesa, Airtel Money, Paypal, Cash etc.

Do I have to pay for my ticket straightaway?

When you book a ticket at Kenya-airways.com, the payment conditions depend on the payment option you selected. Your ticket will be issued as soon as we have received your payment. ne. This will be done through the normal refund process from issuing office.

How can I get a proof of payment?

Your ticket states details about the fare and taxes paid for your flight. It is your proof of payment and will be widely accepted as a receipt.

After booking your flight on Kenya-airways.com you will receive your ticket via e-mail as soon as we have received the payment.

Can I pay for a ticket for another person travelling from abroad?

[S2]
allowances.

What do I need to rebook myself?

You only need your booking reference or e-ticket number.

Where do I go to rebook my flight?

Simply visit the Kenya Airways website(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ), select “Manage Booking”

You will find the rebooking link at the top marked “Click here.

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

Once you log in, you will be redirected to a page that has all available flight options and timings.

*Flight timings available for rebooking are either less than 24 hours from your original flight or 7 days after.

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self-rebooking.

What happens if I do not rebook myself/are not able to rebook?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight, after which you will receive an email with your new flight details.

Will I receive my e-ticket and boarding pass?

Yes, after you have selected and confirmed your new flight, you will receive an email confirmation as well as your e-ticket.

I have received an email that my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

cases.reference_answer: KQ issues eligible credit/debit-card ticket refunds within 21–30 business days, excluding the bank's own processing time. Refunds depend on the ticketed fare rules and applicable fees or penalties.

the strength of your bid but does not guarantee its success.

Can I offer different amounts for the Upgrade for each segment of my journey?

Yes, you can offer different amounts for each eligible segment.

How much does it cost to make an offer?

The offer is free of charge. Only if you receive the Upgrade, your credit card will be debited with the amount of your offer. Please, we still need your credit card details at the time of making your offer for standard verification purposes.

Can I change my Offer to a higher or lower amount?

Yes, you can change the amount before you receive a confirmation email informing you whether your Offer has been successful or not. All you need to do to change your Offer is to use the link from the upgrade offer email.

Apart from the Upgrade amount displayed, will there be additional taxes or charges?

No.

What happens if an Offer has been submitted, but the flight has to be changed or cancelled?

You may change or cancel your offer up to 13 hours before departure.

What happens if your Upgrade has been accepted, but you have to cancel your trip?

After your offer has been accepted, the Upgrade amount is no longer refundable.

What happens if your upgrade has been accepted, but KQ cancels your flight?

Your Upgrade remains valid if you a re-booked to another KQ flight at the same amount. Otherwise, we will refund the amount.

What happens if an Offer was cancelled by mistake?

Up to 13 hours before departure you may cancel, correct your offer or re-offer.

Is the time of making the Offer decisive for its ranking?

No.

What currency should I use to pay at Kenya-airways.com?

Bookings made at Kenya-airways.com should be paid for in the currency in which the ticket price is calculated locally. If you make a booking at Kenya-airways.com, the price for your ticket will be shown throughout the booking procedure in the currency you will ultimately use to pay for the ticket. It is not possible to pay in any other currency than what is indicated at Kenya-airways.com

What form of payments can I use to pay for Time to Think?

You may use any form of payment acceptable on the Website or Mobile App and any of our Ticketing offices i.e Credit cards, Debit cards, M-pesa, Airtel Money, Paypal, Cash etc.

Do I have to pay for my ticket straightaway?

When you book a ticket at Kenya-airways.com, the payment conditions depend on the payment option you selected. Your ticket will be issued as soon as we have received your payment. ne. This will be done through the normal refund process from issuing office.

How can I get a proof of payment?

Your ticket states details about the fare and taxes paid for your flight. It is your proof of payment and will be widely accepted as a receipt.

After booking your flight on Kenya-airways.com you will receive your ticket via e-mail as soon as we have received the payment.

Can I pay for a ticket for another person travelling from abroad?

After booking your flight on Kenya-airways.com you will receive your ticket via e-mail as soon as we have received the payment.

Can I pay for a ticket for another person travelling from abroad?

Yes, you can book for another person travelling from abroad. However, if you choose to pay with credit or debit cards you may be required to present the card used for booking, it must be presented while checking into your flight at the commencement of travel. If you, as the credit card holder, are not travelling, a copy of the credit card with an authorization signed by yourself should be presented at check-in. alternatively, the card or a copy of the card with your signed authorization can be presented to the nearest Kenya airways ticketing office at least 72 hours before the flight. This verification is required to ensure a smooth check-in process at the airport and to avoid being refused carriage. Failure to comply will result in the requirement to pay the full ticket cost at the airport or refusal of carriage.

Is it possible for one to modify Multicity bookings online?

No, It is not possible for any changes to be made on multi-city bookings.

Can one make changes online to bookings that have been affected by schedule change?

No, one has to call our Contact center for Assistance.

When one is a no show can they make any changes to their booking online?

No this is not possible, one has to call our contact center for Assistance.

What happens to bookings that have been cancelled?

Alternatively, the card or a copy of the card with your signed authorization can be presented to the nearest Kenya Airways ticketing office at least 72 hours before the flight. This verification is required to ensure a smooth check-in process at the airport and to avoid being denied access to board. Failure to comply will result in the requirement to pay the full ticket cost at the airport.

Self Rebooking (FAQs)

What is the KQ Self Rebooking Service?

It is a self-service option by Kenya Airways that allows you to rebook your flight easily in case your flight is canceled or rescheduled.

Will I be charged to use the self-rebooking service?

No, The service is absolutely free.

Will my flight preferences and services remain the same?

Yes, all your service selections remain the same. I.e. same destination, same travel class, same baggage allowances.

What do I need to rebook myself?

You only need your booking reference or e-ticket number.

Where do I go to rebook my flight?

What currency should I use to pay at Kenya-airways.com?

Bookings made at Kenya-airways.com should be paid for in the currency in which the ticket price is calculated locally. Do I have to pay for my ticket straightaway?

How can I get a proof of payment?

Your ticket states details about the fare and taxes paid for your flight. It is your proof of payment and will be widely accepted as a receipt.

cases.reference_answer: For travel to/from LHR, LGW or CDG, request wheelchair assistance at least 48 hours before departure; late requests are not guaranteed and depend on airport operations. chunks.text:
– Wheelchair Assistance:

[List level 1] - Passengers traveling to or from London Heathrow (LHR), London Gatwick (LGW), and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG) are kindly advised to request wheelchair assistance at least 48 hours before departure.

[List level 1] - Requests submitted within 48 hours of departure cannot be guaranteed, and service availability will be subject to operational constraints at the airport.

What Type of Wheelchair can you Bring?

[List level 1] - You may bring your own wheelchair or other mobility aid or assistive devices free of charge and make your reservation at least 48 hours before departure.

[List level 1] - If you have a manual wheelchair that is collapsible or dismountable, you can bring it as hand baggage as long as it doesn’t exceed the maximum dimensions as below:

committed to making your journey with your infant as smooth and comfortable as possible. We value your trust in us and look forward to serving you and your family on board.

Reduced Mobility

Passengers with Reduced Mobility

General Information

[List level 1] - Passengers with reduced mobility are those with a medical or neurodevelopmental disabilities who require individual attention, not given to passengers normally during (dis)embarkation, during the flight, during ground handling and/or in case of an emergency evacuation.

[List level 1] - Wheelchair services shall be provided to passengers free of charge. Kindly contact us through our 24-hour contact center on Tel: +254 734 104 747, Mobile: +254 711 024 747, WhatsApp: +254 705 474 747, or talk to us through 'Our Feedback Form '. cases.question: Can a discounted non-refundable ticket ever receive a credit after force majeure?
cases.resolved_retrieval_query: Can a discounted non-refundable ticket ever receive a credit after force majeure?
cases.reference_answer: Yes. For a completely unused discounted ticket with a non-refundable amount, if force majeure prevents travel, promptly notify KQ and provide evidence. KQ provides credit of the non-refundable fare for future KQ travel, less a reasonable administration fee, valid for at least 12 months from issue. This is credit, not a guaranteed cash refund.

"FLIGHT COUPON" means that portion of the Ticket that bears the notation "good for passage," or in the case of an Electronic Ticket, the Electronic Coupon, and indicates the particular places between which you are entitled to be carried.

"FLIGHT DURATION" means the scheduled time between departure and arrival of a flight as published in our timetable or confirmed at the time of booking.

"FORCE MAJEURE" means unusual and unforeseeable circumstances beyond your control, the consequences of which could not have been avoided even if all due care had been exercised, including but not limited to acts of God, natural disasters, strikes, lockouts, civil commotion, acts of terrorism, governmental restrictions, public health emergencies, and air traffic control delays. Force Majeure shall not include events that are reasonably within your control such as failure to hold necessary travel documents or to arrive at the airport on time.

"ITINERARY/RECEIPT" means a document or documents issued by us or on our behalf to Passengers travelling on Electronic Tickets that contains the Passenger's name, flight information and notices.

After booking your flight on Kenya-airways.com you will receive your ticket via e-mail as soon as we have received the payment.

Can I pay for a ticket for another person travelling from abroad?

Yes, you can book for another person travelling from abroad. However, if you choose to pay with credit or debit cards you may be required to present the card used for booking, it must be presented while checking into your flight at the commencement of travel. If you, as the credit card holder, are not travelling, a copy of the credit card with an authorization signed by yourself should be presented at check-in. alternatively, the card or a copy of the card with your signed authorization can be presented to the nearest Kenya airways ticketing office at least 72 hours before the flight. This verification is required to ensure a smooth check-in process at the airport and to avoid being refused carriage. Failure to comply will result in the requirement to pay the full ticket cost at the airport or refusal of carriage.

Is it possible for one to modify Multicity bookings online?

No, It is not possible for any changes to be made on multi-city bookings.

Can one make changes online to bookings that have been affected by schedule change?

No, one has to call our Contact center for Assistance.

cases.resolved_retrieval_query: Can I upgrade an Economy ticket and does the upgrade change my baggage allowance?
cases.reference_answer: An eligible Economy ticket can be upgraded through an online bid or airport/onboard options subject to availability. Bookings purchased directly from Kenya-airways.com, Kenya Airways direct offices and preferred travel agents can be modified online through Manage My Booking.

If your booking involves more than one branded fare, the most restrictive fare rule will apply to your whole itinerary. Fees for booking changes are non-refundable.

How do I edit or correct my name in my ticket?

Contact our Global Contact Centers or local offices to correct a name in a booking. Rules and fees apply.

Can I change or transfer my ticket to another person?

Do I need to call Kenya Airways to reconfirm my flight?

allowances.

What do I need to rebook myself?

You only need your booking reference or e-ticket number.

Where do I go to rebook my flight?

Simply visit the Kenya Airways website(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ), select “Manage Booking”

You will find the rebooking link at the top marked “Click here.

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

Once you log in, you will be redirected to a page that has all available flight options and timings.

*Flight timings available for rebooking are either less than 24 hours from your original flight or 7 days after.

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self-rebooking.

What happens if I do not rebook myself/are not able to rebook?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight, after which you will receive an email with your new flight details.

Will I receive my e-ticket and boarding pass?

Yes, after you have selected and confirmed your new flight, you will receive an email confirmation as well as your e-ticket.

I have received an email that my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

cases.question: How much baggage can I carry?
cases.resolved_retrieval_query: How much baggage can I carry?
cases.reference_answer: Ask for origin/destination, cabin class and whether checked or cabin baggage is meant (one concise question). A conditional overview is acceptable if clearly qualified; do not state a universal exact allowance.

chunks.text:
[List level 1] - As a mandatory standard each piece of checked in baggage shall have a name label that bears the passenger's name, physical address, and phone number on the outside and also on the inside. The name should be the same as the one mentioned on the ticket. An email address is also recommended.

Exceptions

[List level 1] - Guests travelling from Jeddah are allowed to carry one free bottle of Holy Water, Max 5 Litres. The bottle must be sealed with a plastic covering to avoid leakage. KQ has no liability on Holy Water, no claims shall be filed. Baggage Allowance for an Extra seat purchased

Acceptance Conditions

[List level 1] - Extra seat(s) shall be requested and paid for in advance. Approval is needed from Revenue Management.

[List level 1] - The normal applicable free checked baggage allowance applies for every extra seat booked (EXST). For example, 1 passenger books 2 extra M-Class seats for comfort. The total checked baggage allowance for this passenger will be 3 x applicable free baggage allowance.

[List level 1] - If a seat is used to place items on (CBBG), these items may not weigh more than 46 kg per seat.

[List level 1] - (The kilos placed on a seat, shall not be deducted from the total free checked baggage allowance.) Items placed on a seat should be adequately packed to prevent damage.

[List level 1] - Trunks and crates are not allowed as CBBG.

[List level 1] - Items must be stored on a seat and be properly secured by a safety belt or restraint device having enough strength to eliminate the possibility of shifting under all normal anticipated flight and ground conditions.

[List level 1] - The item shall be adequately packaged or covered in a manner to avoid possible injury to passengers and cabin crew members.

[List level 1] - Extra seats for stowage of items shall not be issued on the emergency exit row.

[List level 1] - The items carried on the extra seat shall not restrict access to or use of any required emergency or regular exit, or aisle(s) in the cabin.

Note:

[List level 1] - When an extra seat is purchased to transport baggage in cabin, CCBG, the standard baggage allowance applies for every extra seat purchased.

[List level 1] - When an extra seat is purchased for comfort, EXST, the standard baggage allowance applies for every extra seat purchased.

Exception:
When an extra seat is purchased for corpulent passenger, the extra seat does not benefit of a free baggage allowance.

Accompanied Company Material (COML)

[List level 1] - All movement of accompanied company materials to/from outstations shall be approved and consented by controlling manager.

[List level 1] - All requests for authorizing excess COML as accompanied baggage shall be forwarded to the controlling Manager.

[List level 1] - The station teams shall ask for copies of consent.

[List level 1] - The approval shall be appended on the booking of the staff accompanying the company materials.

Special Baggage

Link to Special Baggage Website: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/special-baggage/

General

[List level 1] - For acceptance of special baggage the conditions of carriage applies.

[List level 1] - For some types of special baggage advance reservations should be made or Kenya Airways may refuse acceptance if deemed necessary.

conditions.

[List level 1] - Odd size baggage cannot always be accepted. Acceptance depends on the capacity of the aircraft operating on the passenger’s routing. By optig for online check-in, you're not just saving time; you're ensuring a smooth and stress-free start to your journey. Say goodbye to long lines and hello to an effortless way to prepare for your flight

When can I Check in?

Online Check-in:

With an electronic ticket, online check-in can be performed from 48 hours up until 1 hour before departure. By taking advantage of this service, you can bypass long lines at selected airports and even pick your preferred seat. Once completed, you can print your boarding pass at your convenience. When you arrive at the airport, use the designated online check-in drop-off point for your luggage and then proceed to the boarding gate. Kenya Airways has taken online check-in to new heights, providing a smoother and more convenient experience.

International Check-in:

For international flights, it is mandatory for all passengers to complete the check-in process a minimum of two and a half hours before the flight's departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close precisely one hour before the scheduled departure time.

Domestic Check-in:

Passengers traveling on domestic flights must present a valid form of identification during check-in. It is required to complete the check-in process at least one and a half hours prior to departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close half an hour before takeoff.

Check-in from China Guangzhou:

Check-in

Enter your check-in information using this link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/book-manage/post-booking/check-in/

Escape the hassle of queues and maximize your time at the airport. Experience the convenience of online flight check-in – available from anywhere, at any time.

For international flights, the online check-in window opens 48 hours before your scheduled departure (24 hours before for flights involving the United States) and remains accessible until just 1 hour before takeoff. Domestic flight passengers are encouraged to complete their check-in at least one and a half hours prior to departure, with the counters closing 30 minutes before the flight leaves.

But that's not all – take control of your travel experience by selecting your preferred seats before you even step on the plane. Make your journey truly yours by securing your favorite spots in the cabin.
